questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Abode
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abode
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Dwelling.'

Key Points

  • The given word 'Abode' means the place where you live. (निवास स्‍थान; घर; आवास)
    • Example: Badrinath is considered the abode of Lord Vishnu.
  • ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
    • 'Dwelling' means the place where a person lives; a house. (निवास-स्‍थान; आवास गृह)
      • Example: Come, sleep in my dwelling tonight.
    • 'Aboard' means on or onto a train, ship, aircraft, or bus. (रेलगाड़ी, जहाज़, विमान या बस पर सवार)
      • Example: The Captain and crew welcome you aboard.
    • 'Annex' means to take control of another country or region by force. (अन्‍य देश पर बलपूर्वक अधिकार कर लेना)
      • Example: Hitler was determined to annex Austria to Germany.
    • 'Habituation' means the action or process of becoming habituated. (अभ्यस्त होने की क्रिया या प्रक्रिया)
      • Example: Habituation, by contrast, reduces responsiveness to the familiar.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information

  • The synonyms of the word 'Abode' are "dwelling, shelter, habitation".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. APPARENTLY
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

APPARENTLY
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Seemingly'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Apparently' is 'Seemingly'.
  • Apparently: according to what people say or to how something appears, but perhaps not true. (ऊपरी तौर से; दृश्‍यमान रूप से)
    • Example: Apparently, he's already been married twice.
  • Seemingly: so as to give the impression of having a certain quality; apparently. (प्रकट रूप से)
    • His strikes were hard and fast and seemingly from every direction.
       

Correct Answer: Seemingly.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Questionably: in a questionable and dubious manner. (एक संदिग्ध तरीके से)
    • Considerably: by a notably large amount or to a notably large extent; greatly. (विशेष रूप से बड़ी मात्रा में या विशेष रूप से बड़ी सीमा तक; बहुत)
    • Unlikely: not likely to happen; not expected; not probable. (असंभावित; अप्रत्‍याशित; असंभाव्‍य)

Hence, the correct answer is Option 4. Let's see the meaning of other given options:-

Words Meaning
Laudable deserving to be appreciated, praised, or admired सराहने योग्य; प्रशंसनीय, सराहनीय

 Desirable  wanted, often by many people; worth having वांछनीय; अपेक्षित

Additional Information 

  • The antonyms of the word 'Despicable' are "admirable, commendable, creditable, laudable, meritorious, praiseworthy".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Paranoid
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Paranoid
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Suspicious"

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Paranoid- wrongly believing that other people are trying to harm you or are saying bad things about you (इस मिथ्‍या संदेह से ग्रस्‍त कि अन्‍य लोग हानि पहुँचाना चाहते हैं या दुर्व्यवहार कर रहे हैं)
    • Suspicious- feeling that somebody has done something wrong, dishonest or illegal (जिसे किसी बात के ग़लत, अनुचित या ग़ैर-क़ानूनी होने का अहसास हो, संदेही या संशयी, संदेहग्रस्‍त या संशयग्रस्‍त)
    • Patronising- to treat somebody in a way that shows that you think you are better, more intelligent, experienced, etc. than he/she is (किसी अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति को अपने से छोटा, कम बुद्धिमान और अनुभवी समझ कर उस पर कृपाभाव का व्‍यवहार करना)
    • Impeccable- without any mistakes or faults; perfect (निर्दोष, त्रुटिहीन; परिपूर्ण)
    • Insignificant- of little value or importance (महत्वहीन, उपेक्षणीय, नगण्य, निरर्थक)
  • Hence, the nearest synonym of the given word is 'Suspicious' i.e. Option 1.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. DELECTABLE

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. FORSAKE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

FORSAKE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- 'desert'
Key Points

  • The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Forsake' is 'desert'.
  • Forsake: to leave someone for ever, especially when they need you (किसी को हमेशा के लिए छोड़ने के लिए, खासकर जब उन्हें आपकी जरूरत हो) 
    • Example: Do not forsake me!
  • Desert: abandon (a person, cause, or organization) in a way considered disloyal or treacherous. परित्यक्त (एक व्यक्ति, कारण, या संगठन) एक तरह से विश्वासघाती या विश्वासघाती माना जाता है।
    • Example: They were lost in the desert for nine days.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information    Let's look at the meaning of other words:

  • Claim: to say that something is true or is a fact, although you cannot prove it and other people might not believe it (यह कहना कि कुछ सच है या तथ्य है, हालांकि आप इसे साबित नहीं कर सकते हैं और अन्य लोग इस पर विश्वास नहीं कर सकते हैं)
  • Help: to make it possible or easier for someone to do something, by doing part of the work yourself or by providing advice, money, support, etc. (किसी के लिए कुछ करना संभव या आसान बनाने के लिए, काम का हिस्सा खुद करके या सलाह, पैसा, सहायता आदि प्रदान करके)
  • Hold: to take and keep something in your hand or arms (अपने हाथ या बाहों में कुछ लेना और रखना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Travail
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Travail
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Agony'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Travail- painful or laborious effort. (दर्दनाक या श्रमसाध्य प्रयास)
    • For Example -  He gained the medal through his painful travail.
    • Adventure- an unusual and exciting or daring experience. (एक असामान्य और रोमांचक या साहसी अनुभव)
    • For Example - He regaled us with wonderful stories of adventure. 
    • Agony- extreme physical or mental suffering. (अत्यधिक शारीरिक या मानसिक पीड़ा)
    • For Example - That level of agony was something she never wanted to go through again.
    • Journey- an act of travelling from one place to another. (एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर जाने की क्रिया या भाव)
    • For Example -  It would be a long journey and a dangerous one.
    • Excursion- a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity. (एक छोटी यात्रा या यात्रा, विशेष रूप से एक अवकाश गतिविधि के रूप में ली गई)
    • For Example -  I have arranged with my classmates for an excursion to the beach.
  • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is Option 2.

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Trail

Trail

  • ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
    • 'Rehearsal' means practice or trial performance of a play or other work for later public performance. (किसी नाटक या अन्य कार्य के सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन से पहले उसका पूर्वाभ्यास)

    • 'Glory' means fame or honour that you get for achieving something. (उपलब्धि से प्राप्‍त यश या सम्‍मान)
      • Example: Better to die in glory than live in dishonor.

  • The word 'Compatible' means "if two people are compatible, they can have a good relationship because they have similar ideas, interests, etc."
    • E.g. She found a compatible partner through a computer dating agency. 
  • According to the meanings of the words and examples given above, 'compatible' is the correct synonym of the word 'congenial'.


Additional Information

  • Let's know the meanings of the other words:
    • Bombastic- sounding important but having little meaning and used to impress people.
    • Aloof- not friendly or interested in other people.
    • Servile- wanting too much to please somebody and obey them.
